propositions: Empty string assignee from outbound_differ reaches JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue and is passed verbatim to JIRA.assign_issue, which treats empty string as a user search query instead of an unassign sentinel.

pycontribs JIRA library requires None (not empty string) as the sentinel for unassign, routing None to PUT /assignee with {"name": null}; empty string either raises JIRAError or arbitrarily assigns the first search result.
JiraDataCenterTransport._assign lacks the empty-assignee guard that Cloud's ACLI transport has, failing to normalize falsy assignee values to None before calling assign_issue.
Test test_outbound_unassign_round_trips expects fields.assignee to be null after local assignee clear, but fails because empty string is not recognized as an unassign instruction.
